entries: This suite features separate rooms to house a number of creatures equal to the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. Each room comes fully furnished and includes a communal refresher station for every four rooms (minimum of one). When a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, their {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite features separate rooms to house a number of creatures equal to half the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. Each room comes fully furnished and includes its own refresher station. When a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, they regain all spent Hit Dice, instead of only half, and their {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Quick-Charge shields
entries: Quick-Charge Shields, opposite of Fortress Shields, offer a reduced capacity, but rapidly replenish.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You add a reactive layer to your ship's hull granting your hull resistance to kinetic damage.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You add a reactive compensator to your ship's shield generator granting your shields resistance to energy damage.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's reactor, at a cost. Your ship's Strength score increases by 1. One ability score other than Strength (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Strength score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's reactor. Your ship's Strength score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Strength score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: You further improve your ship's reactor. Your ship's Strength score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Strength score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You greatly improve your ship's reactor. Your ship's Strength score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Strength score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: You massively improve your ship's reactor. Your ship's Strength score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Strength score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: Your ship's reactor has reached it's maximum potential. Your ship's Strength score increases by 2. Your ship's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite comes with a number of recreational areas equal up to one-fourth the ship’s suite capacity by size (minimum of one), as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. Recreational areas are equipped with integrated artist’s implements, gaming sets, musical instruments, and writer's implements. While making a check with any of these tools in a recreational area, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make if you do not already do so. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus}. If you already double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add half of your governing ability modifier (rounded down, minimum of +1), in addition to your ability modifier. Additionally, while utilizing any of these tools, you gain a benefit based on which tools you are using.

Lastly, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, they gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability check} they make before the start of their next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

items: {@b Gaming set or musical instrument:} While playing one of the gaming sets or musical instruments, you can always readily read the emotions of those paying attention to you. During this time, and for up to one minute after completing, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to read the emotions of those you performed for or competed against.

{@b Artists's implements or writer's implements:} While crafting with these implements, the total market value you can craft per day increases by an amount of credits equal to 5 x your character level. If you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make with them, the market value increases by 10 x your character level.

entries.name: Armor Class
entries: 10 + Dex (max 0)

entries.name: Stealth
entries: {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg}

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite includes the proper equipment necessary for a crewmember to take remote control of another ship from the safety of their own ship. A number of crewmembers can be deployed at a time in remote ships from this suite equal to one quarter of the ship’s suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. The distance at which this suite can connect to remote ships is limited by the communications of the ship this suite is installed in.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You install a remote override that can allow your ship to be controlled from afar, provided the controller has access to a console and transmitter to control the ship from.  If proper credentials are not supplied, a successful Intelligence (Slicer Kit) check (DC = 10 + the ship's Tier + the ship's Intelligence Modifier) is required to control the ship.  If the ship is currently controlled by another party, the check is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}. Your ship’s maximum and minimum crew requirement become 1: the remote controller.  Your starship cannot benefit from features that would increase or decrease its crew capacity. The controller instead controls all aspects of the ship, as if they were deployed inside of it. The starship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability checks} while being remote controlled. This ship can be controlled remotely from a distance of 10,000 feet. Lastly, if an effect would suppress communications for the ship, it cannot be controlled remotely for the duration of that suppression.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: The ship no longer suffers from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability checks} while being remote controlled.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: This modification allows the ship it is installed in to be remotely controlled from anywhere in the system by a properly equipped controller.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: Additionally, your starship’s maximum crew requirement becomes 2, and can support 2 remote controllers.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: Your starship’s maximum crew requirement becomes 3, and can support 3 remote controllers. Additionally, your ship can be remotely controlled from anywhere in the sector by a properly equipped controller.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: This modification allows the ship it is installed in to be remotely controlled from anywhere in the known galaxy by a properly equipped controller.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can unleash a beam of focused energy from a tractor beam of the ship in a 50-foot-wide, 600-foot-long line. Each ship in the line must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship’s Strength modifier). On a failed save, a ship takes 8d6 kinetic damage and is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the beginning of their next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn’t {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's communications systems to make them more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's hull to make it more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's computer to make it more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's reactor to make it more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's sensors to make them more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You overhaul your ship's thruster to make it more adaptive. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws}.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Weapon)
entries: Your primary weapons are mounted to Strike Foils giving your ship variable operational capacities.  As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}, a crewmember can switch between two modes:

items: {@b Locked:} Your ship's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet and your primary weapons suffer a -2 penalty to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls}.
{@b Unlocked:} Your ship's primary weapons gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls}.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade}} 1 This system augments the native radar scanner on your ship. Your ship gains {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 1,000 feet. Additionally, your ship is proficiently equipped for Intelligence (Probe) and Wisdom (Scan) checks.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade}} 2 {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Scanner, Mk I} This modification improves the radar scanner on your ship. Your ship now has {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 2,000 feet. Your ship is expertly equipped for Intelligence (Probe) and Wisdom (Scan) checks.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade}} 3 {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Scanner, Mk II} This modification greatly improves the radar scanner on your ship. Your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Intelligence (Probe) and Wisdom (Scan) checks that rely on scanners.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade}} 4 {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Scanner, Mk III} This modification massively improves the radar scanner on your ship. Your ship gains {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} out to 1,000 feet.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Operation)
entries: This modification implements a secondary transponder code into your ship's sublight engines. This transponder code can differ from your primary transponder code in terms of ship's owner, designation, make and model, any registered modifications, and the ship's ownership history. A crewmember can switch the ship's transponder code as an action. A creature can determine this transponder code is a fake by making an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check (DC = 8 + your ship's bonus to Charisma (Swindle) checks). On a success, they determine that your transponder code is a fake. Additionally, your ship is proficiently equipped for Charisma (Swindle) checks.  If your ship is already proficiently equipped, it is instead considered expertly equipped.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite comes equipped with a full base of security for your ship, including secured storage, a brig, and a compact armory.

items: The secured storage can hold an amount equal to one-tenth the ship's base cargo capacity, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Cargo Capacity} table on page 79. The secured storage is equipped with both a key and a code lock, and is magnetically sealed to prevent it opening in the event of power failure. The secured storage can be accessed with a DC 20 Intelligence ({@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|Security Kit}) check.
The brig can host a number of prisoners equal to one-fourth the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table.

The armory comes equipped with an amount of {@filter simple blasters|items|firearm=true|weaponcategory=simple} and {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}, as well as {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor} and shields, to outfit a force equal to one-half the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. When installed it comes fully stocked with {@item Blaster pistol|sw5e-phb|blaster pistols}, {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} carbines, and {@item Techblade|sw5e-phb|techblades}, as well as combat suits and light shields

entries.name: Grade 0 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship is equipped with a self-destruct mechanism that can cause immense destruction at the expense of the ship. A crewmember can activate the self-destruct mechanism as an action, setting a timer up to 10 minutes in length. When the timer expires, the ship explodes, dealing fire damage to each enemy within range. The damage is calculated as follows; for each Hull Die the ship has, roll it and add the ship's Strength modifier to the roll. The range that the self-destruct mechanism impacts varies, depending on the ship's size:

items: {@b Tiny}: A Tiny ship deals damage to each ship within 50 feet of it.
{@b Small}: A Small ship deals damage to each ship within 100 feet of it.
{@b Medium}: A Medium ship deals damage to each ship within 200 feet of it.
{@b Large}: A Large ship deals damage to each ship within 400 feet of it.
{@b Huge}: A Huge ship deals damage to each ship within 1,000 feet of it.
{@b Gargantuan}: A Gargantuan ship deals damage to each ship within 2,000 feet of it.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's Sensor Array, at a cost. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 1. One ability score other than Wisdom (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Wisdom score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's Sensor Array. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Wisdom score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: You further improve your ship's Sensor Array. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Wisdom score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You greatly improve your ship's Sensor Array. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Wisdom score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: You massively improve your ship's Sensor Array. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Wisdom score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: Your ship's Sensor Array has reached it's maximum potential. Your ship's Wisdom score increases by 2. Your ship's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Operation)
entries: This modification adds a remote sensor dampener to your ship. As an action, a crewmember can attempt to dampen the sensors of a ship they can see within 1,000 feet. The target makes a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your Charisma (Interfere) bonus. On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} for 1 minute. As an action on each of the ship's turns, a crewmember on the affected ship can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges. Additionally, your ship is proficiently equipped for Dexterity (Hide) checks. If your ship is already proficiently equipped, it is instead considered expertly equipped.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship's reactor is overhauled to give temporary boosts to your ship's weapon batteries. When your ship hits another ship with a primary or secondary {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|weapon attack} while it still has {@variantrule Shield Points|sw5e-sotg|shield points}, a crewmember can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} to cause some of the damage to bleed through. The damage the ship's shields take is reduced by an amount equal to your ship's Strength modifier. The ship's hull then takes this much damage. This damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Operation)
entries: This modification adds a shield disruptor to a ship, which is used to interfere with another ship's shield. As an action, a crewmember can activate the shield disruptor and choose a ship they can see within 1,000 feet. You make a Charisma (Interfere) check contested by the target’s Constitution (Regulate) check. On a failed save, the ship’s shield regeneration rate is reduced by half for 1 minute. Additionally they take damage to their shields equal to two of their shield dice. At the start of each of the target ship's turns, a crewmember can use an action to repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success. If a ship is targeted by a larger ship, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. If targeted by a smaller ship, it instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage}. You can end the shield disruptor at any time (no action required).  This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember may choose a Small or smaller ship you can see within 1200 feet. The target must make an Intelligence (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's charisma modifier) {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. On a failed save, it is disabled until the start of your next turn. Each time the ship takes damage or is the target of a hostile power or ability while disabled in this way, it can repeat this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember may upload a computer virus that stalls a ship within 900 feet. Roll 7d6; if the ship’s remaining {@variantrule Hull Points|sw5e-sotg|hull points} are less than the total, the ship is stalled for one minute or until the ship takes damage. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can dictate a one-word command to a ship you can see within 600 feet. The target must succeed on an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's charisma modifier) or follow the command on its next turn. If the ship is directly piloted by a humanoid that is not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, it gains a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} equal to that crewmember’s Intelligence modifier. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can’t follow your command, the ability ends. {@b Approach.} The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. {@b Deactivate.} The target becomes disabled and then ends its turn. {@b Flee.} The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. {@b Halt.} The target doesn’t move and takes no actions. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember may cause a ship that you can see within 600 feet to succeed on an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's charisma modifier) or be disabled for up to a minute, until the feature ends. At the beginning of each of its turns, the ship can make another Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. On a success, the feature ends. The effects of this feature last until the beginning of your next turn unless the crewmember uses a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg} to maintain it. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can choose one ship you can see within 600 feet and attempt to remotely override its controls. The target must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's charisma modifier). If the ship is directly piloted by a humanoid that is not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, it gains a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} equal to that crewmember’s Intelligence modifier. If you or ships that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you for the duration. While the ship is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed}, you have a wireless link with it as long as the two of you are within the same system. Via your ship, you can use this link to issue commands to the ship while you are conscious (using a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as “Attack that ship,” “Move over there,” or “Fly casual.” If the ship completes the order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the ship takes only the actions you choose, and doesn’t do anything that you don’t allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the ship to use a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg}, but this requires you to use your own {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} as well.  For every action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}, or {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} you make the ship use, you must spend an equivalent action. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} against the power. If the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} succeeds, the power ends. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship has been modified to withstand sudden impacts, and to be more effective at ramming. Your ship has resistance to kinetic damage caused by ramming.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship's harpoon has been modified, allowing it to conduct bursts of energy into the harpooned ship. A harpooned ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the contested Strength (Boost) check to remove the harpoon. Additionally, as an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can deal lightning damage to a harpooned ship. The damage is equal to one of your ship's shield Dice + your ship's Strength modifier. Finally, when your ship makes a Strength (Ram) check, it can reroll one of the dice.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Weapon)
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} with the chosen weapon; when you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll} and hit, and the lower of the two {@dice d20} rolls would also hit; when the target ship rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} to avoid the weapon's effects; or when the target ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} and fails, and the higher of the two rolls would also fail, you can force the target to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} + the ship's Strength modifier). On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the start of your next turn. If the damaged ship is larger than your ship, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. If the damaged ship is smaller than your ship, it instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship gains a SubLight Acceleration Motor (SLAM). As an action, a crewmember can activate the SLAM to cause the ship to immediately move forward an amount up to the ship's movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed}.  This movement must be made in a straight line and the ship's heading cannot change during this movement. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once) but no more than once per ship's turn. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship's SubLight Acceleration Motor (SLAM) has been enhanced, granting more utility.  When a crewmember takes the Fly action, the increase now equals twice your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed}, after applying any modifiers. With a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} of 300 feet, for example, your ship can move up to 900 feet on its turn if you Fly. Any increase or decrease to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} changes this additional Movement by the same amount. If your ship's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} of 300 feet is reduced to 150 feet, for instance, your ship can move up to 450 feet this turn if you Fly. This action still affects your entire ship: any skill check or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack roll} made by your ship or anyone on it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: You install a slave circuit in your ship. You reduce the minimum crew requirement by half (minimum of 1).

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You improve the slave circuit in your ship for further automation. You reduce the minimum crew requirement to one quarter (minimum of 1), instead of by half.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: Your ship's slave circuit automates crew functions seamlessly. You reduce the minimum crew requirement to one eighth (minimum of 1), instead of to one quarter.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite offers a single room, equipped with both a key and a code lock, that can house a number of prisoners equal to twice the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. Slave pen doors are magnetically sealed to prevent them opening in the event of power failure. When a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, their {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is not reduced. Additionally, for each week spent in this suite, creatures suffer 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Operation)
entries: This modification adds a stealth device to your ship. This device effectively counteracts or negates the use of scanners, both for and against your ship. A crewmember can activate or deactivate the stealth device as an action. While active, your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Dexterty (Hide) checks that rely on scanners, but your ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on Intelligence (Probe) and Wisdom (Scan) checks that rely on scanners. Additionally, if you try to enter hyperspace while the cloaking device is active, you must roll on the Hyperspace Mishaps table on page 76. Finally, your ship is proficiently equipped for Dexterity (Hide) checks.  If your ship is already proficiently equipped, it is instead considered expertly equipped.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade{@b  3{@i  }}Prerequisite:} {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} Device} This system improves the stealth mode function on your ship. While your stealth device is active, your ship no longer has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on Intelligence (Probe) and Wisdom (Scan) checks that rely on scanners, and no longer has to roll on the Hyperspace Mishaps table before entering hyperspace while stealth mode is active. Additionally, your ship is expertly equipped for Dexterity (Hide) checks. If it is already expertly equipped, it instead gains a bonus equal to half the ship’s tier (rounded up).

entries.name: Grade 3 (Operation)
entries: {@b {@i Modification Grade{@b  3{@i  }}Prerequisite:} {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} Device} This system improves the stealth mode function on your ship. While is active, your ship extends all effects of it's {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} Device to nearby starships for one hour. Additionally, for the duration, each starship you choose within 300 feet of you has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Hide) checks and can’t be tracked except by enhanced means while within this radius.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite increases the cargo capacity on your ship by its base cargo capacity, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Cargo Capacity} table on page 79. This suite's Modification Category Base Cost is only 500 cr.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Weapon)
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-sotg|critical hit} with the chosen weapon, or when the target ship rolls a 1 on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} to avoid the weapon's effects, you can force the target to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} + the ship's Strength modifier). On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of your next turn. If the damaged ship is larger than your ship, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. If the damaged ship is smaller than your ship, it instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet and turning {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Strength 9} Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Strength 11, Sublight Drive, Mk I} Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Strength 13, Sublight Drive, Mk II} Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Strength 15, Sublight Drive, Mk III} Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: {@b {@i Prerequisite:} Strength 17, Sublight Drive, Mk IV} Your ship’s flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} increases by 50 feet.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship is equipped with a weapon designed to disable enemy ships without damaging them through use of a specialized {@item Ion cannon|sw5e-sotg} that delivers a powerful electromagnetic burst. A crewmember can fire the super-heavy {@item Ion cannon|sw5e-sotg} at a target as an action, which has a range of 1,000 feet and a limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}, as described in Chapter 9. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + the crewmember’s {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} + the ship’s Strength modifier). On a failed save, a ship is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. As an action on each of the ship’s turns, a crewmember can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success. If a ship is targeted by a ship two or more sizes larger than them, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on the initial {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. If targeted by a ship two or more sizes smaller, it instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage}. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship’s tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges. If you have more than one Super-{@item Heavy ion cannon|sw5e-sotg} installed, they all share this amount of uses, and each Super-{@item Heavy ion cannon|sw5e-sotg} past the first grants an additional use.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite comes with a number of separate unique stations equal to one-fourth the ship's suite capacity by size (minimum of one), as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. When a techcaster completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, as long as they have their {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} focus, they gain temporary tech points equal to their {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} maximum power level + their Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). When you would spend a tech point while you have temporary tech points, the temporary tech points are spent first. All temporary tech points are lost at the end of your next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Additionally each station is equipped with integrated cybertech’s implements. While making a check with these tools in a supercharger station, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make if you do not already do so. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus}. If you already double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add half of your governing ability modifier (rounded down, minimum of +1), in addition to your ability modifier.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You augment your ship's preventative measures in order to mitigate damage to its systems. When refitting is conducted on your ship, its system damage level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Operation)
entries: You equip your ship with a specialized defensive computer system.  When you would make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, you can instead make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your ship's Wisdom modifier.  All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: Through vicious-looking weaponry, forboding structure, or overwhelming displays of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-sotg|speed} or power, your ship is better able than most to portray itself to enemies as a dangerous element on the battlefield. Your ship is proficiently equipped for Charisma (Menace) checks.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: Your ship gains the ability to fine-tune the readings it displays to enemy craft so as to project how dangerous it is directly to their sensor readouts. As an action, a crewmember can attempt to demoralize one ship within 1,000 feet of your ships that can sense your ship by forcing it to succeed at a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC equal to 8 + your Charisma (Menace) bonus). On a failed save, the target cannot willingly move closer to your ship and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability checks} and {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} while it can sense your ship until the end of your ship's next turn. On a success, the target can’t be affected by this modification for 1 hour. If your ship has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on Charisma (Menace) checks, the targeted ship makes its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} at {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}. Additionally, your ship is expertly equipped for Charisma (Menace) checks.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's thrusters, at a cost. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 1. One ability score other than Dexterity (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Dexterity score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's thrusters. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Dexterity score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: You further improve your ship's Thrusters. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Dexterity score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You greatly improve your ship's Thrusters. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Dexterity score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: You massively improve your ship's Thrusters. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Dexterity score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: Your ship's Thrusters have reached it's maximum potential. Your ship's Dexterity score increases by 2. Your ship's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can dump a load of tibanna gas in a 100-foot cube within 600 feet. For up to a number of rounds equal to your ship's tier, it is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-sotg|difficult terrain} and lightly obscures the area. When the gas appears, each ship in its area must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's constitution modifier) or become ionized. A ship that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. The gas is flammable. Any 50 foot cube of the gas exposed to fire burns away in one round. Each ship that enters the fire or starts it turn there must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can shoot a thin sheet of flames from the ship. Each ship in a 150-foot cone must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's constitution modifier). A ship takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can expel a burst of flame in a line 300 feet long and 50 feet wide, originating from your ship. Each ship in the line must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's constitution modifier). A ship takes 3d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can create a wall of fire within 1200 feet. You can make the wall up to 300 feet on a side and 10 feet thick, or a spherical shell up to 150 feet in diameter, and 10 feet thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for up to a number of rounds equal to your ship's tier. Each ship that enters the fire or starts it turn there must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's constitution modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area. The effects of this feature last until the beginning of your next turn unless the crewmember uses a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg} to maintain it. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can launch tibanna gas canisters, creating a {@spell Firestorm|sw5e-phb|firestorm} in a location they choose within 1500 feet. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 100-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each ship in the area must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + prof. bonus + ship's constitution modifier). It takes 7d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A ship in the area of more than one cube is affected only once. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Engineering)
entries: This modification adds a tractor beam to a ship, which can be used to grasp and guide vessels and debris. As an action, a crewmember can activate the tractor beam, which has a range of 600 feet and a limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}, as described in Chapter 9. Each ship or object of your size or smaller within the {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc} must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship’s Strength modifier). On a failed save, a ship is tractored. An object automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg}, a crewmember can move a tractored ship or object in any direction.  A ship or object two or more sizes smaller than you can be moved up to 200 feet, a ship or object one size category smaller than you can be moved up to 100 feet, and a ship or object your size can be moved up to 50 feet. If at the end of this movement the ship or object strikes another ship or object, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. An object automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. On a failed save, they both take 1d4 kinetic damage. As an action, a crewmember at the helm of the tractored ship can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throws} are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} if the ship is smaller than you. If you attempt to tractor a ship or object larger than you, you can choose to gain the tractored condition and move yourself. You can end the tractor beam at any time (no action required). This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship’s tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges. If you have more than one Tractor Beam installed, they all share this amount of uses, and each Tractor Beam past the first grants an additional use.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can use a ship's tractor beam to move a ship or object one size category larger than the ship or smaller within 900 feet and within the tractor beam's arc. The target must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship’s Strength modifier). An object automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}. On a failed save, the ship or object moves a number of feet in a direction of your choice based on its size. A ship or object two or more size categories smaller than your ship can be moved up to 900 feet, a ship or object one size category smaller can be moved up to 600 feet, a ship or object of the same size category can be moved up to 300 feet, and a ship or object one size category larger can be moved up to 100 feet. If at the end of this movement the ship or object strikes another ship or object, they both take 2d8 kinetic damage. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's Transmitters, at a cost. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 1. One ability score other than Charisma (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Charisma score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Universal)
entries: You improve your ship's Transmitters. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Charisma score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Universal)
entries: You further improve your ship's Transmitters. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Charisma score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Universal)
entries: You greatly improve your ship's Transmitters. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Charisma score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 4 (Universal)
entries: You massively improve your ship's Transmitters. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 1. As normal, you can't increase your ship's Charisma score above the maximum for your size with this system.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Universal)
entries: Your ship's Transmitters have reached their maximum potential. Your ship's Charisma score increases by 2. Your ship's maximum for this score increases by 2.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite offers a single room, or series of rooms, typically located near the cockpit or entrance ramp, featuring a number of seats and individual storage, as well as communal refresher stations (one for every 16 seats), to transport a number of humanoids equal to four times the ship’s suite capacity by size, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table.

entries.name: Grade 3 (Weapon)
entries: This modification can be taken a number of times equal to a ship's Constitution modifier. This modification upgrades the Super-Heavy Turbolaser Battery, Capital Railgun, or Superweapon on your starship. The weapon deals an additional die of damage of the type used by the weapon.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You tune your engine output to allow a crewmember to take the Boost Engines action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg} on their turn.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You tune your shield output to allow a crewmember to take the Boost Shields action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg} on their turn.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Universal)
entries: You tune your weapon output to allow a crewmember to take the Boost Weapons action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-sotg} on their turn.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Weapon)
entries: The Turret Hardpoint is a modification to a Hardpoint that grants an improved {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}. The weapon attached to the chosen Hardpoint now has an unlimited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc} in addition to its limited arc, as described in chapter 9.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember can use a gravity well projector to wrack the hull of a Large or larger ship that you can see within the projector's arc with violent gravwaves. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship’s Strength modifier). On a failed save, it takes 14d6 kinetic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage can’t reduce the target’s {@variantrule Hull Points|sw5e-sotg|hull points} below 1. If the target fails the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, its hull point maximum is reduced until the ship is recharged by an amount equal to the kinetic damage it took. This feature can be used once before a ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Engineering)
entries: Your ship's retrorockets allow it to abruptly reverse its thrust. As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-sotg} on this ship's turn, a crewmember at the helm can activate the retrorockets and immediately move the ship 100 feet directly backward from the direction the ship is facing. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship’s tier (a minimum of once). All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite comes equipped with a vault, which has a capacity equal to half your ship's base cargo capacity, as shown in the {@b Starship Size Cargo Capacity} table on page 79. The vault is equipped with both a key and a code lock, and is magnetically sealed to prevent it opening in the event of power failure. The vault can be accessed with a DC 25 Intelligence ({@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|Security Kit}) check. When the vault is accessed, an alarm sounds in the Bridge and Security Suite (if it exists). If a player rolls a 30 or higher on the Intelligence ({@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|Security Kit}) check to unlock the vault, or has the key or code, the alarm can be bypassed.

entries.name: Grade 5 (Engineering)
entries: As an action, a crewmember may generate a nuclear explosion in a 400-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 1500 feet.  Every ship in that sphere must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship’s Constitution modifier). On a failed save, a target takes 40d6 fire damage and is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of it's next turn from an electromagnetic pulse.  On a success, a ship takes half damage and is not {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}. The explosion spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried. This feature can be used once before a ship is refitted. The Starship Size Modification Cost for this modification is Large, regardless of the size of ship it is installed on.

entries.name: Grade 1 (Weapon)
entries: A weapon slave array is attached to a hardpoint and used to fire the weapon effectively from a remote station.  A crewmember taking the Attack Run, Dogfight, or Harass action and using a weapon equipped to this hardpoint is no longer limited to a forward facing arc. Additionally, when taking the Fire action with a weapon equipped to this hardpoint, a crewmwmber at the helm no longer suffers {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage} with a forward-facing limited arc.

entries.name: Grade 2 (Weapon)
entries: A crewmember at the helm, when taking the Fire action with a weapon equipped to this hardpoint, no longer suffers {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-sotg|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Grade 0 (Suite)
entries: This suite comes with a number of workshops equal up to one-half the ship’s suite capacity by size (minimum of one), as shown in the {@b Starship Size Suite Capacity} table. The workshops are equipped with an integrated armormech’s implements, armstech’s implements, artificer’s implements, audiotech's implements, cybertech’s implements, {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit}, {@item Gadgeteer's implements|sw5e-phb|gadgeteer's implements}, munitions kit, tinker’s implements, and a {@item Trapper's kit|sw5e-phb|trapper's kit}. While making a check with any of these tools in a workshop, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make if you do not already do so. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus}. If you already double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make, you instead add half of your governing ability modifier (rounded down, minimum of +1), in addition to your ability modifier. Additionally, while crafting in a workshop using the integrated tools, the total market value you can craft per day increases by an amount of credits equal to 5 x your character level. If you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-sotg|Proficiency Bonus} to checks you make with them, the market value increases by 10 x your character level. Lastly, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} involving this suite, they gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-sotg|ability check} using tools they make before the start of their next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, except for checks made while using a suite.
